fields.quote: All evaluations are conducted using our internal framework derived from LM-Harness-Evaluation [10], ensuring consistent settings across all models.
fields.reason: Main tables compare MLA and GDN-H that the authors trained and scored themselves under one internal harness with consistent settings, so comparator scores are not taken from other reports.

fields.quote: processing a shared total of 1.4 trillion tokens sampled from the K2 pretraining corpus [50].
fields.reason: The pretraining source is named (K2 corpus) but no categories, proportions, or mixture are given, which is partial rather than none or full. SFT/RL data are likewise only described as subsets of the K2 recipe.

claims.quote: All models were trained with the same FLOPs budget and hyperparameters for a fair comparison.
claims.reason: Authors list the 3:1 KDA-to-MLA hybrid as their own architecture contribution. Table 1 compares ratios including 0:1 at fixed 16-head/16-layer scale, but matching is stated as the same FLOPs budget, not the same token count; KDA vs MLA changes FLOPs per token, so the comparison is confounded and not YES.
